# GenCatalog

> Local AI image and video organizer for Grok Imagine, Arcana Labs, GPT Image, Rogue Studio, Higgsfield, Midjourney, Digen, and Venice.ai. Captures prompts, metadata, and media automatically. Everything stored locally — nothing uploaded anywhere.

## What it does

GenCatalog helps creators recover, remember, and rediscover AI-generated images and videos by keeping files, prompts, source context, notes, and generation details together in a local library.

- Browse, search, and filter your entire AI media library
- Recover old AI work from folders, favorites, downloads, and platform histories
- Full prompt and creative recipe preserved with every generation when available
- Supports Grok Imagine, Arcana Labs, GPT Image, Rogue Studio, Higgsfield, Midjourney, Digen, and Venice.ai
- Color-coded source badges, star ratings, tags, notes, saved searches
- Sub-second grid load times, tested with catalogs of 30,000+ items
- Compare mode: view two generations side by side
- Bulk operations: tag, move, or export dozens of items at once

## Pricing

$99 per year, billed annually through Lemon Squeezy, the Merchant of Record. Free trial: 7 days or 250 saved generations, whichever comes first — no credit card required. The subscription is for one individual on up to three personally controlled devices. While the paid period is active, new capture, imports, scans, and other ways of adding work remain available. After the first successful payment, everything already in the catalog remains fully accessible even if the customer later cancels or lets the subscription lapse. Existing perpetual customers keep the perpetual access and update rights included with their original purchase and do not need to subscribe.

## Privacy

Everything in the creative library is stored locally on your machine. GenCatalog never uploads the library as cloud content and requires no GenCatalog account. The subscription pays for tomorrow; the library is always the customer's.

## Requirements

- macOS or Windows 10/11
- Chrome browser (for the extension)
